whatIs: it's free* is a Spanish-language directory of services with a free plan for developers: hosting and deploy, databases, AI, authentication, email, monitoring, analytics, and more. It currently shows 142 resources across 14 categories.

You can search by product, use case, or technology, and filter by category or with the "Sin tarjeta" (no card) and "Sin registro" (no sign-up) tabs. It's a good fit when you need to set up a project without spending money or want to compare what each free plan offers.
uses: Finding where to host a personal project without entering a credit card.
Choosing a free API or database for a prototype.
Looking for services you can use without signing up to test an idea quickly.
caveats: The limits of each free plan change; confirm the quotas on each service's site before relying on them.
Some services ask for a card to activate the full quota, and others only offer a temporary trial.
pricingNote: Free-to-use directory; the listed services have free plans and, usually, paid ones as well.
idealFor: Developers who want to build projects using only free plans.
